justification: Both surfaces carry a single creature rendered in profile as an outlined relief filling a plain field, which is about as generic a correspondence as figural art offers. A shows a composite anthropomorphic being with a human head in profile, elaborate headgear, and a large feathered wing filled with rows of discs and hatched plumes, while B shows a plain quadruped animal in profile with no ornamental infill, no human elements and no wings; there are no shared attributes, groupings or relationships.
